app.title: Holorado Website Audit Tool
app.subtitle: Crawl a site to find broken links and redirects
form.ssoAutoFollow.hint: Only auto-follows anonymous session-bootstrap forms — forms that ask for credentials are never touched.
form.w3cValidation.hint: Checks each target URL directly with the W3C Nu Checker. If W3C cannot reach a page, its fetched source is checked instead. Requests are spaced one second apart.
form.browserCompatibility: Chrome, Edge, and Whale compatibility audit
form.browserCompatibility.hint: When the dedicated runner is connected, it uses read-only GET navigation to detect runtime errors, overflow, and clipping.
form.safeAudit.hint: Safety policy: only GET pages on registered domains; never click buttons or submit forms. Logout, delete, payment, admin, and similar risky paths are excluded before requesting them.
form.invalidUrl: Enter a valid URL (http:// or https://)
form.needUrl: Enter a start URL or register manual URLs to check
form.manual.title: Manual URL check list
form.manual.hint: Paste one URL per line or upload CSV/TXT/XLSX. Excel uploads are scanned across all cells for URLs.
form.manual.placeholder:
https://example.com/page
www.example.com/about
You can also paste a URL column copied from Excel
form.manual.only: Check manual list only (do not expand discovered links)
form.manual.fileError: Could not read URLs from that file
form.manual.needList: Register at least one URL to use manual-only mode
progress.label: Processed {{processed}} / Queued {{queued}}
report.title: Excel reports
report.hint: Download separate workbooks for developer remediation and management reporting.
report.error: Could not generate the Excel report.
report.browser.notice: Chrome, Edge, and Whale are marked pass/fail only from real executions; unavailable executions remain explicitly unavailable.
report.manager.title: Website automated audit report
report.safeScopeDetail: Only GET navigation and static source, response, and error collection are performed. No buttons, forms, save, edit, or delete actions are used.
report.uncheckedDisclaimer: Not-run or unavailable items are never treated as passing.
report.browser.notRunEvidence: Dedicated browser runner not connected — no pass result without a real execution
report.browser.completedEvidence: Audited {{pages}} URL(s) in a real browser; {{issues}} finding(s)
report.w3c.evidence.pass: Official W3C validation completed with no errors or warnings
report.w3c.evidence.fail: Official W3C validation found errors or warnings
report.w3c.evidence.unavailable: Could not determine due to validator response or access failure
browser.title: Automated browser compatibility audit
browser.running: Running read-only Chrome, Edge, and Whale checks…
browser.estimate.title: Estimated progress
browser.estimate.notice: The estimate may change with the target site's response speed.
browser.unavailable: The runner is not connected or its browsers could not launch; results are unavailable.
browser.name: Browser
browser.safeNotice: Only GET/HEAD requests are allowed. No clicks, input, form submission, login, save, delete, or payment actions are performed.
a11y.disclaimer: This check only covers what can be automated — rendering-based checks like color contrast and keyboard focus visibility are not included. It does not replace WA certification.
